# stb

Sean Barrett's single-file libraries (https://github.com/nothings/stb), unmodified, from the master branch of 2026-10-23:
`stb_image.h` (v2.30, the PNG reader for the button pictures, `port/src/skins.cpp`) and `stb_truetype.h` (the font
rasteriser for the keyboard keys' labels). Licence: public domain, or MIT where public domain does not apply (the choice is
at the end of each file).
